about: Single machine-readable source of truth for project status. README and docs point here and do not restate status. Statuses: MET needs committed evidence tied to an experiment manifest; REPORTED_UNPROVEN was reported by a live session and has no manifest; NOT_MET has no qualifying evidence. Change this file only from evidence, in the same commit as the evidence or the reconciliation note that justifies it.

Reported in issue #1 against runtime commit da885da18d16767c44991ebb91045866d67716ec with an experimental solo-host relay echo. No sanitized evidence and no manifest are committed here.

decisions.source: PR #2 comment by the repository owner
decisions.decision: Results from the current emulator-modified client installation are discovery only. They may not become FACT, close M001 or establish production compatibility. Offline analysis of its already captured sanitized evidence is allowed. Acceptance needs a legitimately supplied compatible client and attributable clean runtime source.

decisions.source: PR #2 comment by the repository owner
decisions.decision: Git history is not rewritten unless a full-history scan finds real credentials, keys, raw platform ids or session material. The scan of 2026-10-05 found only the known classes, so history is left intact.

decisions.source: PR #2 comment by the repository owner
decisions.decision: main is protected with required CI checks, no force-push and no deletion; no second-reviewer requirement while the repository has one maintainer. Private vulnerability reporting is enabled.

decisions.source: PR #2 comment by the repository owner
decisions.decision: The Master Spec states architecture and policy only. This file is the sole source for the current frontier and blockers.

decisions.source: PR #2 comment by the repository owner
decisions.decision: The current noncommercial, non-clean-room replacement runtime is research and reference infrastructure only. A distributable upnext-runtime is either independently written from sanitized contracts and evidence or uses only code whose licence or permission covers the release. No restricted or reference code crosses that boundary.

decisions.source: PR #2 comment by the repository owner
decisions.decision: The reported solo-host and client-leave behaviour stays REPORTED_UNPROVEN until tied to exact committed runtime, client and configuration provenance. The second independent client remains a hard M001 requirement.

blockers.title: Client used for live experiments does not qualify as licensed-unmodified
blockers.detail: Decision D1. The client installation used for live experiments is emulator-modified, so every result from it is discovery only. Acceptance-grade live protocol experimentation is paused until a legitimately supplied, unmodified compatible client is in place. Offline analysis of already captured sanitized evidence may continue.

blockers.title: Second independent client
blockers.detail: Conditions 4 and 5 need a second machine with its own qualifying install and a distinct identity.

blockers.title: Live runtime is not attributable to a commit
blockers.detail: Restart the server and relay from a clean checkout of a recorded commit before any run that is meant to be evidence.

blockers.title: No distributable runtime exists; the research runtime cannot become one
blockers.detail: Decision D5 settles the boundary: the current runtime is research and reference infrastructure only. Still open: a plan for an independent clean-room upnext-runtime written from sanitized contracts and evidence, or a licence or permission that covers release. See docs/license-decision.md.

resolved_blockers.resolution: Decision D4. Volatile frontier and blocker text removed from the Master Spec and the execution contract; both link to this file, enforced by tools/repo/check-state.js.

Decision D2. Full-history scan (tools/repo/scan-history.js) over 230 commits and 382 blobs found only the known account/persona metadata and truncated non-secret digests, plus one synthetic test value. History left intact. Record: docs/privacy-history-cleanup-plan.md.
